notes: Reviewed creator profile for Google DeepMind. Seeds are canonical Google/DeepMind-owned URLs; the tool describes and never fetches them.

terminology.family: The flagship family is Gemini, with generations such as Gemini 1.5 and Gemini 2.0 and sizes such as Nano, Flash, Pro, and Ultra.
terminology.release: A specific Gemini model exposed through an API, e.g. gemini-1.5-pro. Size (Pro) and generation (1.5) identify a line.
terminology.product: The Gemini app (formerly Bard) is a product built on Gemini models and is a separate entity.
terminology.serving: Gemini is served through the Gemini API on Google AI for developers and, separately, through Google Cloud Vertex AI.

naming_rules.subject: family
naming_rules.rule: The family is Gemini. Record generation and size as attributes; do not create a separate family per size.
naming_rules.example: Gemini 1.5 Pro is the Pro size of the Gemini 1.5 generation.

naming_rules.subject: release
naming_rules.rule: The canonical release name is the API model id; the marketing name is an alias.

naming_rules.subject: product
naming_rules.rule: Keep the Gemini app (product) distinct from Gemini models; note the former-Bard alias on the product.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Google DeepMind's official site; authoritative for DeepMind model announcements and research.
source_catalog.verification: Canonical DeepMind site reachable at the Google-owned deepmind.google host.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Google's official blog (The Keyword), AI section; used for Gemini product and launch announcements.
source_catalog.verification: AI section of the Google-owned blog.google host.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Gemini API developer documentation; authoritative for exposed model ids and limits.
source_catalog.verification: Developer documentation under the Google-owned ai.google.dev host.

notes: Attribute Gemini releases to the single Gemini family; record generation and size as attributes.
Keep the Gemini app (product) separate from Gemini model releases.
Record Vertex AI serving as a separate serving-platform / deployment entity.

ambiguities.note: Models are announced under both Google DeepMind and the broader Google brand.
ambiguities.guidance: Attribute the model to Google DeepMind as creator; cite whichever official Google-owned page carried the claim.

ambiguities.note: "Gemini" names both the product (formerly Bard) and the model family.
ambiguities.guidance: Record the app as a product and the models as releases; do not conflate them.

ambiguities.note: "Gemini 1.5 Pro" encodes a generation (1.5) and a size (Pro).
ambiguities.guidance: Split them into structured attributes rather than one opaque name.
